justification: Both depict a single human head dominating the field, with eyes, brow ridge, nose and a mass of hair framing the face, which is a generic correspondence any figural tradition could produce. They differ fundamentally in almost every specific: A is a frontal, radically schematic head with flat lozenge eyes, blank surface and no beard, hat or ornament, while B is a strict profile bust with an elaborate tall headdress, pendant earring, patterned curled hair and beard rendered in regimented rows of ringlets, and a decorated garment with an armlet — an entirely different set of conventions and attributes.
